title: The Extra Second
summary: A 45-second dialogue-free Canvas 2D animated short at Bellwick station where time freezes in mid-motion for twenty-six seconds.
description: A 45-second, dialogue-free animated short set at Bellwick station and painted in native Canvas 2D. A tabby follows the sweeper past travel posters while a porter pushes a loaded trolley and a family waves from the far platform; at the sixth second clockwork, moths, and steam freeze in mid-motion before the station returns to life at 32 seconds. Supports play/pause, timeline scrubbing, and clean HUD toggling.
